text:
incident-bot: Paging: P0 - inference latency spike > 2500ms for /v1/generate (region: us-west). Pager routed to eng-oncall primary @Alice Chen. Incident page: https://infra.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-038

Alice Chen: taking this. Primary here. Marcos you’re my secondary — can you pull pod logs for inference-workers-usw-2?

Marcos Rivera: pulling logs now. running:

```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-workers-usw-2 -c model-runtime --tail=500
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep inference-workers
```

Marcos Rivera: seeing repeated KV cache misses and OOM events around the same window. Also 503 spikes from model-server-1.

Jenna Patel: customer-facing note: CS reports multiple 504s from two customers (acct-451, acct-772). Tagging them on the incident page. Runbook reference: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/inference-latency

Alice Chen: runbook checklist I’m doing (quick pointers):
- confirm model cache hit ratio (metrics -> inference.cache.hit_ratio)
- verify worker memory usage and restart straggler pods
- if cache cold or rebuild stuck, route traffic to fallback-model-quantized-v2
- alert CS with ETA if mitigation takes > 10m

Samir Khan: I can flip the routing to fallback variant if you want. Command I’ll use (will do a canary):

```
# canary 10% to fallback
curl -X POST "https://route-control.redwood.internal/canary" -d '{"service":"/v1/generate","variant":"fallback-model-quantized-v2","pct":10}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Priya Singh: note — there's a coverage gap tomorrow 00:30-02:30 PST (my oncall ends before that). I'll leave handoff details in the rota. If this escalates into a sustained outage, please loop in Platform Eng and Security.

Alice Chen: quick remediation summary (TL;DR):
• Restarted 2 x worker pods with high RSS (kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-workers-usw-2)
• Triggered cache warm-up job for the hot prefix set (internal job: warmup/inference-cache/hotprefixes)
• Samir set canary 10% -> fallback-model-quantized-v2

Marcos Rivera: ops-bot kicked off rolling restart, watching metrics now. Patch applied: increased JVM heap flags for model-runtime from 8g -> 10g (temp).

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Rolling restart initiated by @Marcos Rivera for deployment inference-workers-usw-2 (rev 20260314-3). Watch: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/inference-overview?orgId=1

Jenna Patel: metrics update: token_latency median back down from ~2.6s to 360ms over last 4 minutes, error_rate trending to baseline. I'll message CS with status and ask them to verify. :white_check_mark:

Alice Chen: leaving handoff note for next shift (please take):
- primary: Marcos Rivera until 1779006720 (handoff time)
- secondary: Priya Singh on standby for escalation
- runbook pointers: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/inference-latency (steps: cache, restart, fallback)
- ad-hoc search queries: `severity:ERROR "KV cache miss" namespace:inference` in logs
- known workaround: route 100% to fallback-model-quantized-v2 if recovery stalls > 15m

Samir Khan: accepted — I’ll keep the canary at 10% for 15m then scale to 50% if errors persist.

Priya Singh: added calendar block for tomorrow coverage gap and pinged @ops-team to confirm overlap.

Alice Chen: thanks team — paging will be closed once metrics stable for 10m and CS confirms. leaving this thread for the runbook notes and handoff.

Jenna Patel: CS confirmed reduced impact, monitoring. closing out in 12m if stable. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
